description: Source code for InlineAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying tasks and their activities in an Android intent playground app.

classes.name: InlineAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter managing a list of tasks and highlighting the current task.

classes.name: TaskViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual task items, displaying task ID and associated activities.

methods.name: indexOfRunningTask
methods.description: Finds the index of the current running task based on activity's task ID.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new TaskViewHolder by inflating the layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds task data to the ViewHolder, highlighting the current task.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tasks.

methods.name: setTask
methods.description: Populates the ViewHolder with task details and activity views, setting click listeners.

methods.name: showDialogWithFlags
methods.description: Displays a dialog with activity flags.
